title: Bryant declares for the NBA draft
historical_context: Lower Merion high school guard chose the NBA over college.
why_it_matters: Starts the archive's preps-to-pros context for later reflections on his rookie years.
verification_note: NBA retrospective supports year; exact announcement day not assigned.

title: Charlotte drafts Bryant and trades him to the Lakers
historical_context: Bryant was selected 13th in the 1996 draft.
why_it_matters: Explains why his entire NBA career took place with Los Angeles despite Charlotte holding the draft pick.
verification_note: Year precision; trade mechanics should be checked against transaction records before adding a day.

title: Bryant makes NBA debut
historical_context: Debut as an 18-year-old Laker.
why_it_matters: Anchors early-career interviews and later accounts of growth from the bench.
verification_note: NBA history page explicitly dates debut.

title: Lakers win first title of Bryant era
historical_context: The Lakers beat Indiana in Game 6 of the Finals.
why_it_matters: First title in the 2000-02 three-peat; contextualizes later comparisons of his five rings.
verification_note: NBA history page identifies clinching Game 6 date.

title: Lakers complete three consecutive championships
historical_context: 2000, 2001, and 2002 titles with Shaquille O'Neal.
why_it_matters: Marks the end of the first championship era and frame for the later team split.
verification_note: Year precision; source summarizes the three titles.

title: Colorado criminal case dismissed and Bryant statement released
historical_context: Prosecution moved to dismiss sexual assault charge after accuser said she would not testify.
why_it_matters: A necessary non-basketball chronology entry; dismissal was not a trial verdict.
verification_note: Event date from September 2 report; Bryant statement reproduced by AP/ESPN.

title: Civil case settled
historical_context: Civil suit followed the dismissed criminal case.
why_it_matters: Closes the public legal timeline while preserving that terms were undisclosed.
verification_note: Event date from next-day reporting.

title: Bryant scores 81 against Toronto
historical_context: Lakers beat Toronto during Bryant's 2005-06 scoring peak.
why_it_matters: One of the central game records for studying his individual scoring phase.
verification_note: NBA retrospective explicitly dates and quantifies performance.

title: USA wins Beijing Olympic gold
historical_context: USA defeated Spain 118-107 in the gold medal game.
why_it_matters: Anchors Bryant's shift into an elite defensive role within a multi-star team.
verification_note: FIBA retrospective dates final and Bryant's four-point play.

title: Bryant wins fourth NBA title and first Finals MVP
historical_context: Lakers defeated Orlando in the 2009 Finals.
why_it_matters: Key post-Shaq championship and a pivot in his leadership narrative.
verification_note: Year precision matches NBA season review.

title: Bryant tears left Achilles tendon
historical_context: Injury occurred late in a win against Golden State during playoff pursuit.
why_it_matters: A turning point for the last phase of his career and his own recovery writing.
verification_note: Contemporary article published April 13 describes Friday night April 12 event.

title: Bryant passes Jordan in career scoring
historical_context: The next-day essay Zero identifies the Sunday night milestone.
why_it_matters: Provides the occasion for Bryant's unusually detailed reflection on childhood failure.
verification_note: Official game book dated December 14, 2014 has milestone memo.

title: Bryant announces retirement after 2015-16 season
historical_context: Announcement made through his poem Dear Basketball.
why_it_matters: Primary-source pivot from player identity toward art and teaching.
verification_note: Original poem dated November 29.

title: Bryant scores 60 in final NBA game
historical_context: Final game against Utah ended his 20-year Lakers career.
why_it_matters: Places the final pregame interview beside the performance that concluded his playing career.
verification_note: Lakers historical feature identifies date and 60-point total.

title: The Mamba Mentality book is published
historical_context: Published after Bryant's retirement.
why_it_matters: The archive's most substantial Bryant-authored technical self-explanation.
verification_note: Publisher gives on-sale date.

title: Lakers retire Bryant's No. 8 and No. 24
historical_context: Ceremony occurred after release of Dear Basketball film.
why_it_matters: Formal club recognition of two phases of his career.
verification_note: Lakers article dated ceremony night.

title: Dear Basketball wins animated short Oscar
source: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
historical_context: Animated film adapted the 2015 farewell poem.
why_it_matters: Documents industry recognition of Bryant's creative work after basketball.
verification_note: Academy ceremony page identifies March 4 date and names Dear Basketball, Glen Keane, and Kobe Bryant as winners.

title: Bryant, Gianna Bryant, and seven others die
creator_or_speaker: Kobe Bryant; Gianna Bryant; seven others
historical_context: Helicopter crash in California.
why_it_matters: Essential chronological boundary for distinguishing Bryant's work from posthumous releases.
verification_note: Contemporary obituary names victims collectively; avoid speculative details.

title: Bryant inducted into Basketball Hall of Fame
source: NBA.com / Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame
historical_context: Class of 2020 ceremony was delayed into May 2021.
why_it_matters: Keeps class year distinct from actual enshrinement date.
verification_note: NBA hub states May 14-15 2021 weekend; ceremony on May 15.

title: Shaquille O'Neal traded from Lakers to Miami
historical_context: Ended the 2000-02 Shaq-Bryant championship partnership.
why_it_matters: Defines the starting point of Bryant's next team-building era.
verification_note: Contemporaneous Heat announcement gives date and trade participants.

title: Bryant named 2007-08 NBA MVP
historical_context: Lakers returned to the Finals after the Gasol trade.
why_it_matters: His lone regular-season MVP helps explain the 2008-10 leadership phase.
verification_note: Year precision; NBA award list confirms season.

title: Lakers defeat Boston in 2010 Finals Game 7
historical_context: The 83-79 win clinched Bryant's fifth NBA title.
why_it_matters: Provides exact game evidence for the rematch with Boston and second post-Shaq title.
verification_note: Official NBA game page dates Game 7.

title: USA wins London Olympic gold
historical_context: USA faced Spain again in an Olympic final.
why_it_matters: Second Olympic gold is part of Bryant's national-team record.
verification_note: FIBA final listing dates the game; FIBA 2012 player profile confirms Bryant participation: https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/320-mens-olympic-basketball-tournament/5080/players/145824-kobe-bryant .

title: Bryant wins NBA Slam Dunk Contest as a rookie
historical_context: The Cleveland All-Star Weekend placed the 18-year-old rookie on a national stage.
why_it_matters: Explains why early profiles emphasized sudden visibility before his role on the Lakers was settled.
verification_note: NBA retrospective explicitly gives the February 8 1997 contest date and result.

title: Bryant makes first NBA All-Star appearance
historical_context: Bryant reached the All-Star Game in his second season at age 19.
why_it_matters: Anchors contemporary reporting on the rapid rise in expectations and his subsequent adjustment.
verification_note: NBA play-by-play records Bryant in the February 8 1998 game; NBA Hall of Fame class list identifies 1998 as his first All-Star year.
